gen-gf-phudu-gf-hubot-sans: Chunky and unfussy, Phudu draws its a without a single hairline stroke. And Hubot Sans follows with a modern, wide-mouthed e, so the heavy top line gives way to something lighter underneath.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic: Phudu draws everything with one flat, unmodulated stroke weight. Against it, IBM Plex Sans Arabic feels approachable and clean, its open apertures giving the page a lighter, easier-going counterpart to that bold heading.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ibm-plex-sans-devanagari: Phudu looks like it was traced with a marker. IBM Plex Sans Devanagari sits underneath with loose, rope-like curves that never knot at the ends, giving the sans-serif text a modern, easygoing feel.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew: Phudu holds the steady line of a technical drafting pen, while IBM Plex Sans Hebrew keeps its s and c uncrowded below it. Bold meets approachable.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: IBM Plex Sans JP reads like a plain sans, professional and approachable, with every curve finishing in a clean open gap. Phudu's wire-like tubular letters hang above it.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ibm-plex-sans-kr: Bold, distinctive Phudu runs one monoline stroke from start to finish. IBM Plex Sans KR is the modern sans-serif beneath it, leaving every curve end open so the text feels light next to that heading.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: Fat, round and hard to miss, Phudu makes every curve as thick as a straight stem. And IBM Plex Sans Thai, with c-ends pointing apart like pincers, would get crowded out if the heading shrank.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-loope: Distinctive from the first glance, Phudu keeps one unbroken line weight from terminals to junctions. And IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped, clean and neutral with curves that refuse to close, is where that single quality really shows against the heading.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-imprima: Bold and a bit cheeky, Phudu opens its curves generously and draws them with a plain, pressure-free line. Imprima sits below as a neutral, approachable plain sans, its tube-like lines flaring outward at the terminals.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-inclusive-sans: Inclusive Sans reads as a professional, contemporary plain sans, its round letters having rims that match the stems. Phudu gets the bold, distinctive heading role, while Inclusive Sans keeps every curved letter open-ended below it.
